name: Aureon, The Dawnfather
title: Sovereign of the Unbroken Sun & Forge of Law
symbol: Golden Sunburst emblazoned over a Crowned Anvil
worshippers: Paladins of the Silver Gauntlet, Clerics, Judges, Smiths, and Sun-Sworn Magistrates
tenets: Bring the light of truth to shadow-haunted places; suffer no undead abomination to walk.
Honor sworn oaths and defend the weak with steel and shield.
Temper justice with mercy, but strike down unrepentant tyranny without hesitation.

pietyBoons.3: Devotee of the Dawn (Piety 3+): You can cast Light at will, and you gain Advantage on saving throws against being Blinded or Frightened.
pietyBoons.10: Sun-Blessed Warden (Piety 10+): You can cast Daylight or Crusader's Mantle once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot.
pietyBoons.25: Radiant Aegis (Piety 25+): You gain Resistance to Radiant and Necrotic damage. When you use Help or Healing Word, the ally gains Temp HP equal to your level.
pietyBoons.50: Champion of the Unbroken Sun (Piety 50+): Increase Wisdom or Charisma by +2 (to a max of 22). Your weapon and spell attacks deal an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

description: Worshipped inside the grand marble cathedral of Highspire, Aureon is the radiant architect of civilization, righteous law, and solar renewal.

name: Sylvara, Mother of the Wild Weave
title: Keeper of the Ancient Oak & Emerald Tide
symbol: Silver Crescent Moon cradled within Antlered Oak Branches
worshippers: Druids, Rangers, Sailors, Herbalists, and Wardens of the Whispering Woods
tenets: Preserve the ancient groves, rivers, and wild beasts from greedy despoilers.
Walk in harmony with the cycle of storm, bloom, and autumn decay.
Shelter travelers lost in the wilds who show respect to the old ways.

pietyBoons.3: Child of the Root (Piety 3+): You learn Druidcraft and can cast Speak with Animals once per Short Rest.
pietyBoons.10: Walker of the Canopy (Piety 10+): Difficult terrain composed of nonmagical plants or mud doesn't cost you extra movement; cast Pass without Trace 1/Long Rest.
pietyBoons.25: Storm-Bough Guardian (Piety 25+): Resistance to Lightning and Poison damage. Summoned beasts/fey gain +10 temporary HP.
pietyBoons.50: Avatar of the Wild Weave (Piety 50+): Increase Wisdom or Constitution by +2 (max 22). Cast Commune with Nature or Awaken 1/Long Rest without components.

description: Revered at the Iron-Oak of Oakhaven and the standing stones of the Whispering Woods, Sylvara embodies the untamed heartbeat of the natural world.

name: Kordath, Lord of the Iron Storm
title: The Thunder-Strider & Patron of Valor
symbol: Crossed Greatswords struck by a Forked Lightning Bolt
worshippers: Barbarians, Fighters, Gladiators, Mercenaries, and Storm-Sailors
tenets: Test your mettle against worthy foes; never cower before overwhelming odds.
Strength is meant to break chains, never to forge them.
Celebrate victory with thunderous song and honor the glorious dead.

pietyBoons.3: Thunderous Grip (Piety 3+): Your carrying capacity doubles, and you gain Advantage on Athletics checks to grapple or shove.
pietyBoons.10: Stormborn Charge (Piety 10+): Cast Thunderwave or Heroism (2nd level) 1/Long Rest. +5 ft. walking speed.
pietyBoons.25: Fury of the Gale (Piety 25+): When you score a Critical Hit, thunder erupts dealing 2d8 Thunder damage to the target and pushing it 10 ft.
pietyBoons.50: Scion of the Iron Storm (Piety 50+): Increase Strength or Constitution by +2 (max 22). Immunity to Thunder damage and the Prone condition.

description: His shrines are found in arena halls, mountain peaks, and ship prows. Kordath laughs in the hurricane and blesses warriors who charge headlong into peril.

name: Oghma-Vael, Keeper of the Eternal Ledger
title: The All-Seeing Scribe & Weaver of Stars
symbol: An Open Silver Tome surmounted by a Starry Eye and Quill
worshippers: Wizards, Bards, Artificers, Cartographers, Archivists, and Detectives
tenets: No true knowledge should be burned; record history faithfully in the great ledger.
Unravel riddles, ciphers, and arcane mysteries wherever they lie hidden.
Wield magic with discipline, lest hubris invite a second Cataclysm.

pietyBoons.3: Scholar's Eye (Piety 3+): Cast Comprehend Languages or Identify as a Ritual in 1 Action once per Long Rest. +2 to Passive Investigation.
pietyBoons.10: Astral Recall (Piety 10+): Gain proficiency or Expertise in Arcana or History. Cast Augury or Detect Thoughts 1/Long Rest.
pietyBoons.25: Weaver's Ward (Piety 25+): Advantage on Concentration saving throws and saving throws against Illusion spells.
pietyBoons.50: Archmage of the Eternal Ledger (Piety 50+): Increase Intelligence or Wisdom by +2 (max 22). Recover one adicionales 5th-level or lower spell slot on a Short Rest.

description: Patron of the Arcane Ledger itself, Oghma-Vael records every deed, spell, and fallen empire across the planes.

name: Vespera, The Whispering Shadow
title: Lady of the Eclipse, Secrets & Silent Blades
symbol: A Weeping Obsidian Mask beneath a Total Lunar Eclipse
worshippers: Circle of the Pale Moon, Obsidian Syndicate Assassins, Shadow Monks, Warlocks
rivals: Oghma-Vael, Keeper of the Eternal Ledger
tenets: Every secret is a blade; hold it to the throat of the powerful.
Move unseen in the dark; let the light-blinded fools boast while you claim the prize.
Thin the veil between the mortal world and the eternal quiet of the Shadowfell.

pietyBoons.3: Cloak of Dusk (Piety 3+): You gain Darkvision out to 60 ft. (or +30 ft. if you already have it) and Advantage on Stealth checks in dim light.
pietyBoons.10: Shadow Step Initiate (Piety 10+): Cast Invisibility or Darkness once per Long Rest without a spell slot.
pietyBoons.25: Whisper in the Vein (Piety 25+): Once per turn when you hit a creature with Advantage, deal an extra 2d6 Necrotic or Psychic damage.
pietyBoons.50: Harbinger of the Eclipse (Piety 50+): Increase Dexterity or Charisma by +2 (max 22). You can teleport 60 ft. between shadows as a Bonus Action.

description: Venerated in the flooded vaults of the Sunken Ward Catacombs, Vespera promises forbidden power to those who embrace the coming eclipse.

name: Malakor, The Chained Fiend of the Pit
title: Archdevil of Ash, Blood Contracts & Iron Tyranny
symbol: A Crown of Nine Burning Iron Spikes dripping Molten Gold
worshippers: Fiend Warlocks, Ruthless Usurers, Tyrants, Oathbreaker Knights, Infernal Cultists
rivals: Sylvara, Mother of the Wild Weave
Kordath, Lord of the Iron Storm
tenets: Bind the desperate in ironclad pacts; every favor carries a compounding price.
Rule through fear, discipline, and overwhelming hellfire.
Seek the Obsidian Key to unbind the ancient planar seals.

pietyBoons.3: Hellfire Brand (Piety 3+): You gain Resistance to Fire damage and learn the Thaumaturgy cantrip.
pietyBoons.10: Infernal Rebuke (Piety 10+): Cast Hellish Rebuke (2nd level) or Command (2nd level) 1/Long Rest.
pietyBoons.25: Soul-Tax Collector (Piety 25+): Whenever you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP, you gain Temporary HP equal to your level + Charisma modifier.
pietyBoons.50: Paragon of the Nine Chains (Piety 50+): Increase Charisma or Intelligence by +2 (max 22). Fire damage you deal ignores Fire Resistance.

description: An ancient archfiend bound beneath the world during the Cataclysm whose whispers offer wealth, vengeance, and eldritch mastery.
